steps.description: Review project requirements and objectives.
Identify target audience and their preferred communication style.
Outline content structure including sections, subheadings, and tone.
Set deadlines for each section based on priority and timeline.
Document the plan in a shared document accessible by team members.
Conduct thorough research on industry trends, competitor analysis, and user needs.
Gather relevant data and references from internal sources like company reports and customer feedback.
Access external databases, APIs, and online resources for additional insights.
Organize collected information into an organized spreadsheet or database.
Update the research phase notes regularly throughout the day.
Write the first draft of the content following the outlined structure.
Edit and refine the text according to style guides and audience preferences.
Use templates and formatting guidelines provided by the client or organization.
Ensure all technical terms are accurately defined and referenced.
Save drafts in version control systems like GitLab or Bitbucket.
Have peers or subject matter experts review the initial draft.
Address any comments or suggestions made during peer reviews.
Make necessary adjustments to improve clarity, flow, and accuracy.
Seek further feedback if needed from other stakeholders.
Finalize the content before submission.
Convert written content into HTML format suitable for publishing.
Prepare images, videos, and other multimedia elements for inclusion.
Upload formatted content to the designated website or platform.
Optimize page load times and ensure accessibility features are enabled.
Launch the new content and monitor its performance.
